WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    totals.pageviews,
    totals.transactions,
    date,
    CASE WHEN totals.transactions >= 1 THEN 'purchase' ELSE 'non_purchase' END AS classification,
    FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH)) AS month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170601' AND '20170731'
    AND totals.pageviews IS NOT NULL
),
visitor_month_class AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    month,
    classification,
    SUM(pageviews) AS total_pageviews
  FROM sessions
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId, month, classification
),
avg_by_group AS (
  SELECT 
    month,
    classification,
    AVG(total_pageviews) AS avg_pageviews
  FROM visitor_month_class
  GROUP BY month, classification
)
SELECT 
  month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'purchase' THEN avg_pageviews END) AS avg_pageviews_purchase,
  MAX(CASE WHEN classification = 'non_purchase' THEN avg_pageviews END) AS avg_pageviews_non_purchase
FROM avg_by_group
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

-- Build the full query:
-- 1. Filter stations: begin <= '20000101' AND end >= '20190630'
-- 2. Count valid days in 2019 (temp, max, min all non-missing)
-- 3. Check if valid_days / 365 >= 0.90
-- 4. Count such stations

WITH station_valid_days AS (
  SELECT stn, COUNT(*) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019`
  WHERE temp != 9999.9 AND max != 9999.9 AND min != 9999.9
  GROUP BY stn
),
qualifying_stations AS (
  SELECT s.usaf
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s
  WHERE s.`begin` <= '20000101' AND s.`end` >= '20190630'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as count_stations
FROM qualifying_stations qs
JOIN station_valid_days svd ON qs.usaf = svd.stn
WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(svd.valid_days, 365) >= 0.90

-- Final answer: percentage of weather stations with valid temp data for >= 90% of days in 2022
WITH station_days AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    COUNT(DISTINCT date) as total_days,
    SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
                AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
                AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
),
station_pct AS (
  SELECT 
    stn,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(valid_days, total_days) as valid_pct
  FROM station_days
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN valid_pct >= 0.9 THEN stn END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 as percentage
FROM station_pct

WITH 
wind_data AS (
  SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE) AS date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) AS wdsp
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2011` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2012` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2013` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2014` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2015` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2016` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2017` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2018` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT CAST(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da) AS DATE), SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2019` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
  UNION ALL SELECT date, SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2020` WHERE stn = '744860' AND wban = '94789' AND SAFE_CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64) != 999.9
),
daily_totals AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) AS complaint_date, COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date)
),
daily_by_type AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date) AS complaint_date, complaint_type, COUNT(*) AS type_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_date) BETWEEN 2011 AND 2020
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(DATE FROM created_date), complaint_type
),
qualifying_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type FROM daily_by_type GROUP BY complaint_type HAVING SUM(type_count) > 3000
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT d.complaint_date, d.complaint_type,
    CAST(d.type_count AS FLOAT64) / CAST(t.total_count AS FLOAT64) AS daily_proportion,
    w.wdsp AS wind_speed
  FROM daily_by_type d
  JOIN daily_totals t ON d.complaint_date = t.complaint_date
  JOIN qualifying_types q ON d.complaint_type = q.complaint_type
  JOIN wind_data w ON d.complaint_date = w.date
),
corr_data AS (
  SELECT complaint_type,
    COUNT(*) AS n,
    SUM(daily_proportion) AS sum_x,
    SUM(wind_speed) AS sum_y,
    SUM(daily_proportion * daily_proportion) AS sum_x2,
    SUM(wind_speed * wind_speed) AS sum_y2,
    SUM(daily_proportion * wind_speed) AS sum_xy
  FROM daily_proportions
  GROUP BY complaint_type
)
SELECT 
  complaint_type,
  ROUND(
    (n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / 
    NULLIF(SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 0),
    4
  ) AS pearson_correlation
FROM corr_data
WHERE n > 1
ORDER BY ABS((n * sum_xy - sum_x * sum_y) / NULLIF(SQRT((n * sum_x2 - sum_x * sum_x) * (n * sum_y2 - sum_y * sum_y)), 0)) DESC
LIMIT 2

-- Final query: top 5 zip_code/hour combinations by trip count on Jan 1, 2015
WITH hourly_trips_2015 AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(t.pickup_datetime), DAY) as trip_date,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2015` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2015-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-02'
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY z.zip_code, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(t.pickup_datetime), DAY), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime)
),
hourly_trips_2014 AS (
  SELECT 
    z.zip_code,
    DATE_TRUNC(DATE(t.pickup_datetime), DAY) as trip_date,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime) as hour,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2014` t
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` z
    ON ST_CONTAINS(z.zip_code_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(t.pickup_longitude, t.pickup_latitude))
  WHERE t.pickup_datetime >= '2014-12-18'
    AND t.pickup_datetime < '2015-01-01'
    AND t.pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
    AND t.pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY z.zip_code, DATE_TRUNC(DATE(t.pickup_datetime), DAY), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM t.pickup_datetime)
),
ny_zip_codes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT zip_code 
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.zip_codes` 
  WHERE state_code = 'NY'
),
hours AS (
  SELECT 0 as hour UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
  UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9
  UNION ALL SELECT 10 UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 UNION ALL SELECT 14
  UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19
  UNION ALL SELECT 20 UNION ALL SELECT 21 UNION ALL SELECT 22 UNION ALL SELECT 23
),
all_combinations AS (
  SELECT ny.zip_code, h.hour
  FROM ny_zip_codes ny
  CROSS JOIN hours h
),
jan1_data AS (
  SELECT 
    ac.zip_code,
    ac.hour,
    COALESCE(h2015.trip_count, 0) as trip_count
  FROM all_combinations ac
  LEFT JOIN hourly_trips_2015 h2015 
    ON ac.zip_code = h2015.zip_code AND ac.hour = h2015.hour
    AND h2015.trip_date = '2015-01-01'
),
metric_1hr AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date = '2014-12-31' AND hour = 23
),
metric_24hr AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date = '2014-12-31'
),
metric_168hr AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date = '2014-12-25'
),
metric_336hr AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date = '2014-12-18'
),
hist_14day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count 
  FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date >= '2014-12-18' AND trip_date < '2015-01-01'
),
hist_21day AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour, trip_count 
  FROM hourly_trips_2014 
  WHERE trip_date >= '2014-12-11' AND trip_date < '2015-01-01'
),
ma14 AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour,
    AVG(trip_count) as moving_avg_14day,
    STDDEV(trip_count) as moving_stddev_14day
  FROM hist_14day
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
ma21 AS (
  SELECT zip_code, hour,
    AVG(trip_count) as moving_avg_21day,
    STDDEV(trip_count) as moving_stddev_21day
  FROM hist_21day
  GROUP BY zip_code, hour
),
final AS (
  SELECT 
    j.zip_code,
    j.hour,
    j.trip_count,
    COALESCE(m1hr.trip_count, 0) as trips_1hr_ago,
    COALESCE(m24hr.trip_count, 0) as trips_24hr_ago,
    COALESCE(m168hr.trip_count, 0) as trips_168hr_ago,
    COALESCE(m336hr.trip_count, 0) as trips_336hr_ago,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ma14.moving_avg_14day, 0), 2) as moving_avg_14day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ma14.moving_stddev_14day, 0), 2) as moving_stddev_14day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ma21.moving_avg_21day, 0), 2) as moving_avg_21day,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ma21.moving_stddev_21day, 0), 2) as moving_stddev_21day
  FROM jan1_data j
  LEFT JOIN metric_1hr m1hr ON j.zip_code = m1hr.zip_code
  LEFT JOIN metric_24hr m24hr ON j.zip_code = m24hr.zip_code AND j.hour = m24hr.hour
  LEFT JOIN metric_168hr m168hr ON j.zip_code = m168hr.zip_code AND j.hour = m168hr.hour
  LEFT JOIN metric_336hr m336hr ON j.zip_code = m336hr.zip_code AND j.hour = m336hr.hour
  LEFT JOIN ma14 ON j.zip_code = ma14.zip_code AND j.hour = ma14.hour
  LEFT JOIN ma21 ON j.zip_code = ma21.zip_code AND j.hour = ma21.hour
)
SELECT * FROM final
ORDER BY trip_count DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  FORMAT_DATE('%m-%d', date) as date_mmdd
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
WHERE country_code = 'US' AND aggregation_level = 0 AND date BETWEEN '2020-03-01' AND '2020-04-30'
ORDER BY 
  CASE 
    WHEN LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date) > 0 
    THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(new_confirmed - LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date), LAG(new_confirmed) OVER (ORDER BY date))
    ELSE NULL 
  END DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH yearly_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64)) as avg_2019,
    (SELECT AVG(CAST(symptom_anosmia AS FLOAT64)) 
     FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly` 
     WHERE sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
     AND date >= '2020-01-01' AND date <= '2020-12-31') as avg_2020
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_symptom_search.symptom_search_sub_region_2_weekly`
  WHERE sub_region_2 IN ('Bronx County', 'Queens County', 'Kings County', 'New York County', 'Richmond County')
  AND date >= '2019-01-01' AND date <= '2019-12-31'
)
SELECT 
  avg_2019,
  avg_2020,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(avg_2020 - avg_2019, avg_2019) * 100 as percentage_change
FROM yearly_avgs

SELECT 
    za.zipcode,
    za.zipcode_geom AS polygon,
    za.area_land_meters,
    za.area_water_meters,
    za.latitude,
    za.longitude,
    za.state_code,
    za.state_name,
    za.city,
    za.county,
    SUM(p.population) AS total_population
FROM `bigquery-public-data.utility_us.zipcode_area` za
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_usa.population_by_zip_2010` p
    ON za.zipcode = p.zipcode
WHERE ST_DWithin(ST_GeogPoint(za.longitude, za.latitude), ST_GeogPoint(-122.3321, 47.6062), 10000)
    AND p.gender IN ('male', 'female')
    AND p.minimum_age IS NULL
    AND p.maximum_age IS NULL
GROUP BY za.zipcode, za.zipcode_geom, za.area_land_meters, za.area_water_meters, za.latitude, za.longitude, za.state_code, za.state_name, za.city, za.county
ORDER BY za.zipcode

WITH tract_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        t2011.geo_id,
        t2011.total_pop as pop_2011,
        t2018.total_pop as pop_2018,
        t2011.median_income as income_2011,
        t2018.median_income as income_2018,
        SAFE_DIVIDE(t2018.total_pop - t2011.total_pop, t2011.total_pop) as pop_pct_increase,
        (t2018.median_income - t2011.median_income) as income_abs_increase
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2011_5yr` t2011
    JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.censustract_2018_5yr` t2018
        ON t2011.geo_id = t2018.geo_id
    WHERE t2011.geo_id LIKE '36047%'
        AND t2011.total_pop > 1000
        AND t2018.total_pop > 1000
),
pop_ranked AS (
    SELECT geo_id, pop_2011, pop_2018, pop_pct_increase,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pop_pct_increase DESC) as pop_rank
    FROM tract_changes
),
income_ranked AS (
    SELECT geo_id, income_abs_increase, income_2011, income_2018,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY income_abs_increase DESC) as income_rank
    FROM tract_changes
)
SELECT 
    p.geo_id,
    p.pop_rank,
    ROUND(p.pop_pct_increase * 100, 2) as pop_pct_increase_pct,
    p.pop_2011,
    p.pop_2018,
    i.income_rank,
    i.income_abs_increase,
    i.income_2011,
    i.income_2018
FROM pop_ranked p
JOIN income_ranked i ON p.geo_id = i.geo_id
WHERE p.pop_rank <= 20 AND i.income_rank <= 20
ORDER BY p.pop_rank

WITH filtered_shots AS (
  SELECT 
    shot_type,
    event_coord_x,
    event_coord_y,
    shot_made,
    team_basket,
    -- Adjust coordinates based on documentation
    CASE 
      WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN event_coord_x
      ELSE 1128 - event_coord_x
    END AS adjusted_x,
    CASE 
      WHEN event_coord_x < 564 THEN 600 - event_coord_y
      ELSE event_coord_y
    END AS adjusted_y
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ncaa_basketball.mbb_pbp_sr`
  WHERE scheduled_date < TIMESTAMP('2018-03-15')
    AND shot_type IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_x IS NOT NULL
    AND event_coord_y IS NOT NULL
    -- Ensure shots are on the correct side of the court based on team's basket
    AND (
      (team_basket = 'left' AND event_coord_x < 564)
      OR
      (team_basket = 'right' AND event_coord_x >= 564)
    )
)
SELECT 
  shot_type,
  AVG(adjusted_x) AS avg_x,
  AVG(adjusted_y) AS avg_y,
  COUNT(*) AS avg_attempts,
  SUM(CASE WHEN shot_made = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS avg_made
FROM filtered_shots
GROUP BY shot_type
ORDER BY shot_type

WITH utah_counties AS (
  SELECT geo_id AS geoid, county_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.geo_us_boundaries.counties`
  WHERE state_fips_code = '49'
),
employment_2000 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_2000
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2000_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN 'q1' AND 'q4'
  AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
),
employment_2018 AS (
  SELECT geoid, AVG(month3_emplvl_23_construction) AS avg_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls_qcew.2018_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN 'q1' AND 'q4'
  AND geoid LIKE '49%'
  GROUP BY geoid
)
SELECT 
  uc.county_name,
  e2000.avg_2000,
  e2018.avg_2018,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(e2018.avg_2018 - e2000.avg_2000, e2000.avg_2000) AS pct_increase
FROM utah_counties uc
LEFT JOIN employment_2000 e2000 ON uc.geoid = e2000.geoid
LEFT JOIN employment_2018 e2018 ON uc.geoid = e2018.geoid
WHERE e2000.avg_2000 > 0
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

WITH bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) AS avg_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) AS avg_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) AS avg_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) AS avg_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18`
  WHERE year = 2021
    AND (subsector IN ('Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals', 'Software publishers', 'Data processing, hosting, and related services')
         OR industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services')
),
google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_white
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
race_diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    'White' AS race,
    g.race_white AS google_pct,
    b.avg_white AS bls_avg_pct,
    g.race_white - b.avg_white AS difference
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Asian' AS race,
    g.race_asian,
    b.avg_asian,
    g.race_asian - b.avg_asian
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Black or African American' AS race,
    g.race_black,
    b.avg_black,
    g.race_black - b.avg_black
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    'Hispanic or Latino' AS race,
    g.race_hispanic_latinx,
    b.avg_hispanic,
    g.race_hispanic_latinx - b.avg_hispanic
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
)
SELECT 
  race,
  ROUND(difference, 4) AS percentage_difference
FROM race_diffs
ORDER BY ABS(difference) DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS monthly_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.chicago_crime.crime`
  WHERE primary_type = 'MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT'
    AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2016
  GROUP BY year, month
),
max_per_year AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    MAX(monthly_count) AS highest_monthly_count
  FROM monthly_counts
  GROUP BY year
)
SELECT year, highest_monthly_count
FROM max_per_year
ORDER BY year

SELECT
  t.TradeReportID AS tradeID,
  t.MaturityDate AS tradeTimestamp,
  CASE
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'MOMO' THEN 'Momentum'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'LUCK' THEN 'Feeling Lucky'
    WHEN LEFT(t.TargetCompID, 4) = 'PRED' THEN 'Prediction'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS algorithm,
  t.Symbol AS symbol,
  t.LastPx AS openPrice,
  t.StrikePrice AS closePrice,
  s.Side AS tradeDirection,
  CASE WHEN s.Side = 'SHORT' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END AS tradeMultiplier
FROM `bigquery-public-data.cymbal_investments.trade_capture_report` t,
UNNEST(t.Sides) s
ORDER BY t.StrikePrice DESC
LIMIT 6

-- Final query:
WITH condition_acres AS (
    SELECT 
        p.evaluation_group,
        p.evaluation_group_description,
        p.evaluation_type,
        p.evaluation_description,
        c.condition_status_code,
        c.state_code,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * SAFE_CAST(c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted AS FLOAT64) * SAFE_CAST(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot AS FLOAT64)) as subplot_acres,
        SUM(p.expansion_factor * SAFE_CAST(COALESCE(c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted, 0) AS FLOAT64) * SAFE_CAST(p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot AS FLOAT64)) as macroplot_acres
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
    LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p 
        ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
        AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
        AND c.state_code = p.state_code
    WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
    GROUP BY p.evaluation_group, p.evaluation_group_description, p.evaluation_type, p.evaluation_description, c.condition_status_code, c.state_code
),
group_condition_total AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        condition_status_code,
        state_code,
        SUM(subplot_acres) as total_subplot_acres,
        SUM(macroplot_acres) as total_macroplot_acres
    FROM condition_acres
    GROUP BY evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, condition_status_code, state_code
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        evaluation_group,
        evaluation_group_description,
        condition_status_code,
        state_code,
        total_subplot_acres,
        total_macroplot_acres,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
    FROM group_condition_total
),
best_per_group AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
),
eval_type_ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.evaluation_group,
        ca.evaluation_type,
        ca.evaluation_description,
        ca.state_code,
        ca.condition_status_code,
        ca.subplot_acres,
        ca.macroplot_acres,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.evaluation_group ORDER BY ca.subplot_acres DESC) as type_rn
    FROM condition_acres ca
    INNER JOIN best_per_group bg 
        ON ca.evaluation_group = bg.evaluation_group
        AND ca.condition_status_code = bg.condition_status_code
)
SELECT 
    bpg.evaluation_group_description as evaluation_group,
    etr.evaluation_type,
    bpg.condition_status_code,
    etr.evaluation_description,
    CAST(bpg.state_code AS STRING) as state_code,
    bpg.total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres,
    bpg.total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM best_per_group bpg
INNER JOIN eval_type_ranked etr 
    ON bpg.evaluation_group = etr.evaluation_group
    AND bpg.condition_status_code = etr.condition_status_code
    AND etr.type_rn = 1
ORDER BY bpg.total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10

combined AS (

natality_2018 AS (

WITH new_users AS (
  SELECT
    id AS user_id,
    creation_date AS signup_date,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM creation_date) AS signup_month
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.users`
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM creation_date) = 2021
),
user_first_question AS (
  SELECT
    u.user_id,
    u.signup_date,
    u.signup_month,
    MIN(q.creation_date) AS first_question_date
  FROM new_users u
  LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` q
    ON u.user_id = q.owner_user_id
    AND q.creation_date >= u.signup_date
    AND q.creation_date < TIMESTAMP_ADD(u.signup_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY u.user_id, u.signup_date, u.signup_month
),
monthly_totals AS (
  SELECT
    signup_month,
    COUNT(*) AS total_users
  FROM new_users
  GROUP BY signup_month
),
users_who_asked AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    signup_month,
    first_question_date
  FROM user_first_question
  WHERE first_question_date IS NOT NULL
),
user_first_answer AS (
  SELECT
    ua.user_id,
    ua.signup_month,
    COUNT(*) AS has_answer
  FROM users_who_asked ua
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_answers` a
    ON ua.user_id = a.owner_user_id
    AND a.creation_date > ua.first_question_date
    AND a.creation_date <= TIMESTAMP_ADD(ua.first_question_date, INTERVAL 30 DAY)
  GROUP BY ua.user_id, ua.signup_month
)
SELECT
  mt.signup_month,
  mt.total_users,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(ua.user_id), mt.total_users) * 100, 2) AS pct_asked,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(fa.user_id), COUNT(ua.user_id)) * 100, 2) AS pct_answered
FROM monthly_totals mt
LEFT JOIN users_who_asked ua
  ON mt.signup_month = ua.signup_month
LEFT JOIN user_first_answer fa
  ON ua.user_id = fa.user_id
GROUP BY mt.signup_month, mt.total_users
ORDER BY mt.signup_month

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT 
        id,
        title,
        view_count,
        tags,
        CASE 
            WHEN tags LIKE '%android-layout%' THEN 'android-layout'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%android-activity%' THEN 'android-activity'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%android-intent%' THEN 'android-intent'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%android-edittext%' THEN 'android-edittext'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%android-fragments%' THEN 'android-fragments'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%android-recyclerview%' THEN 'android-recyclerview'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%listview%' THEN 'listview'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%android-actionbar%' THEN 'android-actionbar'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%google-maps%' THEN 'google-maps'
            WHEN tags LIKE '%android-asynctask%' THEN 'android-asynctask'
        END AS tag
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.stackoverflow.posts_questions` 
    WHERE (LOWER(title) LIKE '%how%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%how%')
    AND NOT (LOWER(title) LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(title) LIKE '%trouble%'
        OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%fail%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%problem%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%error%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%wrong%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%fix%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%bug%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%issue%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%solve%' OR LOWER(body) LIKE '%trouble%')
    AND (tags LIKE '%android-layout%' OR tags LIKE '%android-activity%' OR tags LIKE '%android-intent%' OR tags LIKE '%android-edittext%' OR tags LIKE '%android-fragments%' OR tags LIKE '%android-recyclerview%' OR tags LIKE '%listview%' OR tags LIKE '%android-actionbar%' OR tags LIKE '%google-maps%' OR tags LIKE '%android-asynctask%')
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT id, title, view_count, tag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY view_count DESC) as rn
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT tag, id, title, view_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 50
ORDER BY tag, rn

WITH living_patient_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.id as patient_id, n.family as last_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.patient` p
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(p.name) as n
  WHERE n.family IS NOT NULL
    AND n.family LIKE 'A%'
    AND (p.deceased IS NULL OR p.deceased.boolean != TRUE)
),
patient_one_condition AS (
  SELECT lpn.patient_id
  FROM living_patient_names lpn
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
    ON c.subject.patientId = lpn.patient_id
  WHERE c.clinicalStatus = 'active'
  GROUP BY lpn.patient_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) = 1
),
patient_condition_map AS (
  SELECT 
    lpn.patient_id,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].code as condition_code,
    c.code.coding[OFFSET(0)].display as condition_display
  FROM living_patient_names lpn
  JOIN patient_one_condition poc ON lpn.patient_id = poc.patient_id
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.condition` c
    ON c.subject.patientId = lpn.patient_id
  WHERE c.clinicalStatus = 'active'
),
patient_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    pcm.patient_id,
    pcm.condition_code,
    pcm.condition_display,
    COUNT(DISTINCT mr.medication.codeableConcept.coding[OFFSET(0)].code) as num_active_meds
  FROM patient_condition_map pcm
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.fhir_synthea.medication_request` mr
    ON mr.subject.patientId = pcm.patient_id
  WHERE mr.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY pcm.patient_id, pcm.condition_code, pcm.condition_display
),
condition_max_meds AS (
  SELECT 
    condition_code,
    condition_display,
    MAX(num_active_meds) as max_distinct_meds
  FROM patient_meds
  GROUP BY condition_code, condition_display
)
SELECT 
  condition_display as condition_name,
  condition_code,
  max_distinct_meds
FROM condition_max_meds
ORDER BY max_distinct_meds DESC, condition_code ASC
LIMIT 8

pitcher_team_valid AS (

WITH yearly_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    item_number,
    item_description,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    SUM(sale_dollars) AS total_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.iowa_liquor_sales.sales`
  WHERE date >= '2022-01-01' AND date < '2024-01-01'
    AND bottles_sold > 0
  GROUP BY item_number, item_description, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
)
SELECT 
  item_number,
  item_description,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END),
    1
  ) AS revenue_2022,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END),
    1
  ) AS revenue_2023,
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END),
      SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END)
    ) * 100,
    2
  ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM yearly_sales
GROUP BY item_number, item_description
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 THEN total_revenue ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH wustl_l2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Imaging_Assay_Type, entityId, HTAN_Data_File_ID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level2_metadata_r5` 
  WHERE HTAN_Center = 'HTAN WUSTL'
  AND Component IS NOT NULL
  AND Component NOT LIKE '%Auxiliary%'
  AND Component NOT LIKE '%OtherAssay%'
  AND Imaging_Assay_Type != 'Electron Microscopy'
),
wustl_l3 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT entityId, HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level3_segmentation_metadata_r5`
),
wustl_l4 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT entityId, HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID
  FROM `isb-cgc-bq.HTAN_versioned.imaging_level4_metadata_r5`
),
l2_levels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level2' as data_level
  FROM wustl_l2
),
l3_levels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level3' as data_level
  FROM wustl_l2 w
  JOIN wustl_l3 l3 ON w.entityId = l3.entityId OR w.HTAN_Data_File_ID = l3.HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID
),
l4_levels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT w.Imaging_Assay_Type, 'Level4' as data_level
  FROM wustl_l2 w
  JOIN wustl_l4 l4 ON w.entityId = l4.entityId OR w.HTAN_Data_File_ID = l4.HTAN_Parent_Data_File_ID
),
all_levels AS (
  SELECT * FROM l2_levels
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM l3_levels
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM l4_levels
)
SELECT Imaging_Assay_Type, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT data_level, ', ' ORDER BY data_level) as available_levels
FROM all_levels
GROUP BY Imaging_Assay_Type
ORDER BY Imaging_Assay_Type

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_time) as year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'active' THEN s.station_id END) as active_stations,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.status = 'closed' THEN s.station_id END) as closed_stations
FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_stations` s
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.austin_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` t 
    ON s.station_id = t.start_station_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_time) IN (2013, 2014)
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year

WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    COUNT(*) as daily_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.austin_incidents.incidents_2016`
  WHERE UPPER(descript) = 'PUBLIC INTOXICATION'
  GROUP BY date
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(daily_count) as mean_count,
    STDDEV(daily_count) as stddev_count
  FROM daily_counts
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    d.date,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(d.daily_count - s.mean_count, s.stddev_count) DESC) as rnk
  FROM daily_counts d
  CROSS JOIN stats s
)
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m-%d', date) as date
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 2

SELECT 
  zip_code
FROM `bigquery-public-data.fdic_banks.locations`
WHERE state = 'FL'
GROUP BY zip_code
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH corn_production AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    SUM(value) AS corn_bushels
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usda_nass_agriculture.crops`
  WHERE year = 2022
    AND agg_level_desc = 'STATE'
    AND statisticcat_desc = 'PRODUCTION'
    AND value IS NOT NULL
    AND commodity_desc = 'CORN'
    AND group_desc = 'FIELD CROPS'
    AND unit_desc = 'BU'
  GROUP BY state_name
),
mushroom_production AS (
  SELECT 
    state_name,
    SUM(value) AS mushrooms_production
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usda_nass_agriculture.crops`
  WHERE year = 2022
    AND agg_level_desc = 'STATE'
    AND statisticcat_desc = 'PRODUCTION'
    AND value IS NOT NULL
    AND commodity_desc = 'MUSHROOMS'
    AND group_desc = 'HORTICULTURE'
  GROUP BY state_name
),
all_states AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT state_name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usda_nass_agriculture.crops`
  WHERE year = 2022 AND agg_level_desc = 'STATE' AND state_name != 'OTHER STATES'
)
SELECT 
  s.state_name,
  COALESCE(c.corn_bushels, 0) AS corn_bushels,
  COALESCE(m.mushrooms_production, 0) AS mushrooms_production
FROM all_states s
LEFT JOIN corn_production c ON s.state_name = c.state_name
LEFT JOIN mushroom_production m ON s.state_name = m.state_name
ORDER BY s.state_name

WITH visitor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId) AS total_unique_visitors
  FROM `data-to-insights.ecommerce.web_analytics`
),
purchaser_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT fullVisitorId) AS unique_purchasers,
    SUM(totals.transactions) AS total_transactions
  FROM `data-to-insights.ecommerce.web_analytics`
  WHERE totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  SAFE_DIVIDE(pc.unique_purchasers, vc.total_unique_visitors) AS conversion_rate,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(pc.total_transactions, pc.unique_purchasers) AS avg_transactions_per_purchaser
FROM visitor_counts vc, purchaser_counts pc

WITH navy_transactions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ecommerce.transaction_id
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`,
  UNNEST(items) i
  WHERE event_name = 'purchase'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND i.item_name = 'Google Navy Speckled Tee'
)
SELECT i.item_name, SUM(i.quantity) as total_qty
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*` e,
UNNEST(e.items) i
WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase'
  AND e._TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
  AND e.ecommerce.transaction_id IN (SELECT transaction_id FROM navy_transactions)
  AND i.item_name != 'Google Navy Speckled Tee'
GROUP BY i.item_name
ORDER BY total_qty DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH page_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.value.string_value as page_location,
    p2.value.int_value as ga_session_id,
    SPLIT(p.value.string_value, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(4)] as seg5,
    SPLIT(p.value.string_value, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(5)] as seg6,
    SPLIT(p.value.string_value, '/')[SAFE_OFFSET(6)] as seg7
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210102` e
  CROSS JOIN UNNEST(e.event_params) p
  LEFT JOIN UNNEST(e.event_params) p2 ON p2.key = 'ga_session_id'
  WHERE e.event_name = 'page_view'
    AND p.key = 'page_location'
    AND p.value.string_value LIKE '%shop.googlemerchandisestore.com/Google+Redesign/%'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    page_location,
    ga_session_id,
    CASE 
      WHEN seg6 IS NOT NULL AND seg6 != '' AND seg6 LIKE '%+%' THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN seg7 IS NOT NULL AND seg7 != '' THEN 'PDP'
      WHEN seg5 IS NOT NULL AND seg5 != '' AND seg5 LIKE '%+%' AND seg6 IS NULL THEN 'PDP'
      ELSE 'PLP'
    END as page_type
  FROM page_data
),
sessions_with_pdp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ga_session_id
  FROM classified
  WHERE page_type = 'PDP'
),
plp_in_pdp_sessions AS (
  SELECT c.*
  FROM classified c
  INNER JOIN sessions_with_pdp s ON c.ga_session_id = s.ga_session_id
  WHERE c.page_type = 'PLP'
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as plp_views_leading_to_pdp,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(*), (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classified WHERE page_type = 'PLP')) * 100 as percentage
FROM plp_in_pdp_sessions

WITH purchase_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id') AS ga_session_id,
    ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201101' AND '20201130'
    AND event_name = 'purchase'
    AND ecommerce.purchase_revenue_in_usd IS NOT NULL
),
session_revenue AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    ga_session_id,
    SUM(purchase_revenue_in_usd) AS session_revenue
  FROM purchase_events
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id, ga_session_id
),
user_purchase_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    s.user_pseudo_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.ga_session_id) AS num_purchase_sessions,
    AVG(s.session_revenue) AS avg_purchase_revenue_per_session
  FROM session_revenue s
  GROUP BY s.user_pseudo_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.ga_session_id) > 1
)
SELECT 
  user_pseudo_id,
  avg_purchase_revenue_per_session
FROM user_purchase_sessions
ORDER BY user_pseudo_id

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT p.value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS p WHERE p.key = 'page_location') AS page_location
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
    AND (SELECT p.value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS p WHERE p.key = 'page_location') IS NOT NULL
    AND (SELECT p.value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS p WHERE p.key = 'page_location') LIKE '%shop.googlemerchandisestore.com%'
),
cleaned AS (
  SELECT
    page_location,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(page_location, r'https?://shop\.googlemerchandisestore\.com(/.*)?$') AS page_path
  FROM page_views
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    page_path,
    COUNT(*) AS page_views,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn
  FROM cleaned
  GROUP BY page_path
)
SELECT page_path
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 2

-- Final calculation with rounding
WITH uninstall_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181010'
  AND event_name = 'app_remove'
  AND user_first_touch_timestamp >= 1535769600000000
  AND user_first_touch_timestamp <= 1538361599000000
  AND event_timestamp <= user_first_touch_timestamp + 604800000000
  AND event_timestamp >= user_first_touch_timestamp
),

crash_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_pseudo_id
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE event_name = 'app_exception'
)

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    SAFE_DIVIDE(
      COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cu.user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL THEN u.user_pseudo_id END),
      COUNT(*)
    ) * 100.0,
    2
  ) as percentage
FROM uninstall_users u
LEFT JOIN crash_users cu ON u.user_pseudo_id = cu.user_pseudo_id
